description: One room with a counter across it and plank shelves to the ceiling behind. Tins, bread, rice, soap, batteries and water, priced in chalk on the shelf edges. Osric works the till from a stool, with the strongbox chained to his ankle under the counter.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it's doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
